services.name: New Smyrna Boat Tours
services.desc: Climb aboard a classic old Maine lobster boat for a relaxed 3-hour sunset charter through Mosquito Lagoon and Ponce Inlet. This isn’t a crowded tour-it’s a laid-back, intimate experience where you can slow down, sip wine, and take in the natural beauty of the Space Coast. As we cruise the calm backwaters of Mosquito Lagoon, keep an eye out for local wildlife. Dolphins are often seen swimming alongside the boat, and manatees regularly surface in the shallows. Sea turtles pop up from time to time, and the area is full of birdlife-from pelicans diving for fish to ospreys and herons gliding overhead.
